observations.title: Failure to perform release testing and establish stability program
observations.summary: The firm did not perform appropriate laboratory testing to confirm identity and strength of each batch before release and lacked an adequate written stability testing program with reliable methods.

observations.title: Failure to investigate out‑of‑specification results
observations.summary: The firm failed to thoroughly investigate unexplained discrepancies, including viscosity OOS results from stability testing, and did not provide adequate root‑cause analysis, CAPA, or justification.

observations.title: Improper storage conditions for drug products
observations.summary: The firm stored drug products at temperatures exceeding labeled and internal limits, failing to maintain appropriate temperature, humidity, and light conditions and not including storage requirements on COAs.
